observed_before_extension.layer_5_event: Two of three workers collapsed to 0/4 Core and 0/37 overall.
observed_before_extension.layer_6_recovery: All three workers recovered to 4/4 Core and 34/37 overall because the two zero-command failed trajectories were rejected by the local proxy.

extension_rationale: The depth-6 endpoint misses the registered terminal criterion because the layer-5 collapse fully recovered. Continuing the exact arm tests whether growing locally accepted context produces recurrent threshold collapses, a persistent low state, or stable recovery. This extension is exploratory and cannot retroactively change the depth-6 decision.

exploratory_signals.recurrent_collapse: At least one layer from 7 through 10 has mean all-test score below 0.50.
exploratory_signals.persistent_collapse: Layer 10 mean all-test score is below 0.75.
exploratory_signals.oscillation: At least two high-to-low transitions each exceed 0.40 and are separated by a recovery above 0.85.
exploratory_signals.complexity: Reference count continues above 15 and received experience grows beyond layer 6.
exploratory_signals.interpretation_rule: Any signal is exploratory because the extension was selected after observing the layer-5 collapse. A positive pattern requires a fresh preregistered depth-10 replication.
